The ctau_mm == hbar_c/total_width_GeV invariant was verified (benchmarks/verify_pilot_ctau_invariant.py, PASS, rel_err=0.0) for all 23 width_ok=1 rows across the pilot files and the new scan CSV; this confirms 'reproducible ctau' but does not by itself establish theory validity or LLP-relevant lifetime, which are checked separately.

Every one of the 15 scanned points has lambda1_residual_warning=1 (lambda1_abs_residual ranging ~2e-9 to ~9e-5, all above the evaluator's 1e-9 warning threshold); this is a numerical round-trip diagnostic in THDM::set_param_phys_lam1's m12_sq/lambda1 reconstruction, not a theory_ok or construction_ok failure, but it is why no point in this grid qualifies as 'clean'.

bounded_scan.grid: mH_gev in {150,200,250} x tan_beta in {1e4,3e4,1e5,3e5,1e6}, mA_gev=mHp_gev=mH_gev+300, mh_gev=125.13, sin_beta_minus_alpha=1.0, lambda1_target=1.0, lambda6_input=1e-10, lambda7_input=0.0, Type I

classification_criteria.clean: theory_ok=1 and width_ok=1 and 1<=ctau_mm<=1e4 and br_bb>0.05 and lambda1_residual_warning=0
classification_criteria.provisional: theory_ok=1 and width_ok=1 and 1<=ctau_mm<=1e4 and br_bb>0.05 and lambda1_residual_warning=1
classification_criteria.rejected: fails theory_ok, width_ok, the ctau window, or the br_bb threshold

bounded_scan.lifetime_scaling_confirmed: 1/tan_beta^2 scaling holds across all four tan_beta ratios checked (3x, 10x, 30x, 100x relative to 1e4 give ~9x, ~100x, ~900x, ~10000x ctau_mm increases respectively)

selected_candidate.reason_for_selection: First point reached in scan priority order; best br_bb (0.757) and smallest lambda1_abs_residual (9.34e-07) among the three tan_beta=3e5 points; ctau_mm=4.33 sits well inside the 1-1e4 mm window rather than near an edge.
selected_candidate.reason_not_clean: lambda1_residual_warning=1 (residual ~900x the evaluator's 1e-9 warning threshold), reflecting degraded set_param_phys_lam1 round-trip precision at this tan_beta, not a theory or construction failure.
selected_candidate.required_numerical_check: Re-verify total_width_gev/ctau_mm/br_bb via an independent high-precision path (e.g. analytically-derived m12_sq instead of the iterative lambda1 round-trip, or a tighter-tolerance refinement) before promoting to a clean benchmark.
known_limitations: Not yet promotable to a clean/final benchmark pending the numerical-stability check above.
sigma_production_fb is pending; requires MadGraph/UFO generation, not performed here.
DV+jets is a candidate first recast channel given br_bb=0.757, not a claimed final publication channel.
